title: Cladux registry source
description: What `cladux build` turns into a registry: your items and their files. Dependencies are found from the imports.

style.description: The style your files are written in. Defaults to the style in cl.json, or tailwind.

css.description: Also build the plain-CSS style from the Tailwind files, so projects without Tailwind can install your items. Defaults to true when your files use Tailwind.

stylesheet.description: The stylesheet with @import "tailwindcss" your components are styled against. Defaults to css.globals in cl.json.

output.description: Where the registry is written. Defaults to public/r, so a Next.js or Vite site serves it at /r.

name.description: What people type after `cladux add`: lowercase words joined by dashes.

files.description: The item's files, from the project root. A file's type comes from the item's type, and .css files are css.

docs.description: A Markdown file with usage and props, shown by `cladux docs`.
